high_level_description: The image is an advertisement for a "Curated Bundle" from the brand "madewithspin." The bundle is labeled as a "Work from Home" set, with a focus on a specific product called the "Cole Extenso Table." The table is prominently displayed in the center of the image, featuring a vibrant teal color with a modern, minimalist design. The table has a rectangular top supported by four straight legs. The price of the bundle is listed as Rs. 32,474.00, which is marked down from the original price of Rs. 36,083.00.
